platforms.name: Upwork
platforms.how_to_apply: Visit https://www.upwork.com/signup/ - fill in profile, verify email, complete your profile with skills and portfolio. Takes 1-3 days for approval.
platforms.notes: Largest freelance platform. Very competitive. Cloudflare protection blocks automated browsing but registration is open. 5-20% service fee based on lifetime billings.

platforms.name: Fiverr
platforms.how_to_apply: Visit https://www.fiverr.com/startselling - sign up with email or Google. Create your first 'gig' (service offering). Human verification challenge blocks bots.
platforms.notes: Good for beginners - you create gigs and buyers come to you. 20% service fee on earnings. Verification required (human challenge).

platforms.name: Toptal
platforms.how_to_apply: Apply at https://www.toptal.com/talent/apply - Sign up with LinkedIn or email. Pass verbal English test + deep technical vetting (4-8 hours). Takes 2-5 weeks.
platforms.notes: Most selective platform (top 3%). Only accepts highly experienced professionals. High rates but very hard to pass vetting. Newsweek #1 most reliable.

platforms.name: Guru.com
platforms.how_to_apply: Visit https://www.guru.com/registeraccount.aspx - free account creation. SafePay payment protection. Lowest platform fees in industry.
platforms.notes: 800K freelancers, $250M paid to freelancers. SafePay protects payments. Lowest fees (5-9% vs industry 10-20%). Good for all experience levels.

platforms.name: Arc.dev
platforms.average_rates: Above-market pay (companies save up to 58% vs traditional hiring)
platforms.how_to_apply: Visit https://arc.dev/developers - create profile, complete communication + technical vetting, receive interview invites. Free for talent until hired.
platforms.notes: Top 2% talent, vetted for communication + domain expertise. Free for freelancers. 450K talent in 190 countries. $0 cost until company hires you.

platforms.name: Lemon.io
platforms.how_to_apply: Visit https://lemon.io/ and click 'For developers' or 'Find jobs' - 1,500+ manually vetted developers. Average matching time: 24 hours.
platforms.notes: Focused on EU/LatAm/US developers. AI/ML specialization a plus. 2.3M hours worked since 2015. Month-to-month flexibility. Good for startups.

platforms.name: Indeed (Freelance)
platforms.how_to_apply: Visit https://www.indeed.com/freelance-jobs - search and apply directly to freelance postings. Upload resume.
platforms.notes: Not a traditional freelance platform but aggregates freelance/contract job postings. Good for finding short-term remote work across many fields.

platforms.name: Codersera
platforms.how_to_apply: Visit https://codersera.com/ - click 'Apply as a Freelancer'. 20,000+ vetted contractors. 1-week risk-free trial for companies.
platforms.notes: Exclusive network of vetted contractors. Targets tech companies needing remote dev teams. 4.9/5 rating from 1,095 reviews. No credit card required to start.

ai_focused_notes: Toptal - specifically lists 'AI Engineers' as top priority
Lemon.io - explicitly highlights 'AI Engineer' and 'Machine Learning Engineer' as specializations
Arc.dev - data science and full-stack development in high demand
Upwork - AI/ML category growing rapidly ($50-200+/hr for prompt engineering, LLM work)
Codersera - AI-adjacent development (ML engineers, data engineers)
new_platforms_2026_notes: Most major platforms (Upwork, Fiverr, Guru, Toptal) are well-established and still actively accepting freelancers
AI-focused freelance platforms are emerging but most are variants of existing networks (Lemon.io, Arc.dev)
No major brand-new freelance platform found as of 2026-04-20
AI engineering and LLM/prompt engineering are the fastest-growing freelance categories across all platforms
